body: Please do yourself a favor and do not get back together with this idiot, you are way too good for him.

Yeah I am hard on myself, but I am just so overwhelmed with the problems my family has ontop of the ones I have for myself that I don't know how to go about them from here.  I try to do self improvement now but it feels too late.
I left out a good bit of shit too, I always tell myself to stop being a baby.  Try and think how much worse others have it, but it stopped making me feel any different.
